title: CropGuard
body:
# CropGuard

Prevents farmland trampling by players.

## Features
- Lightweight and configurable.
- Server-side only.
- Works on Paper/Spigot/Purpur.

## Permissions
- `cropguard.bypass`

## Config (snippet)
```yml
allow-creative: true
```

## Compatibility
- Server: Paper, Spigot, Purpur
- Minecraft: 1.16.5 - 1.21.4
